:::{#exm-closed-under}
#### Closed and not closed

- The [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd) integers are closed under addition:
  for example, $2 + 4 = 6$ is even, and $2m + 2n = 2(m + n)$ is even for all integers $m$ and $n$.
- The odd integers are not closed under addition:
  $1$ and $3$ are odd, but $1 + 3 = 4$ is even.
- The [collection](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-collection) of all [subsets](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-subset) of a [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) $S$ is closed under [union](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-union):
  the union of two subsets of $S$ is again a [subset](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-subset) of $S$.

:::
